caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: transition, mid range · 1d: transition, below range · 4h: range, below range · 1h: transition · 15m: range, near range bottom. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.

Une clôture 4h de retour au-dessus de 2298.67 signifierait que la cassure par le bas a échoué et que le prix a réintégré le range.
